Hey there! Welcome to Snapgrove v1.8.0. 🥳

If you've ever had a minor panic attack wondering whether moving 50 screenshots would accidentally overwrite something, or watched a gallery scramble your selections during a fast fling, this release is for you. We went deep into the engine to make organizing your messy screenshot piles completely stress-free.

This major milestone release gives you:
- Bulletproof multi-selection locked to real file identities, so rapid scrolling and re-sorting never mess with your selections. 🤩
- Transactional file moving with clear progress, plus an exact-match Undo that never hijacks older files of the same name.
- Instant Windows recycling via native Win32 Shell integration, deleting items in under two milliseconds with zero lag. 😎
- Official Windows desktop packages (.zip) now built, Authenticode-signed, and published directly alongside Android APKs.
- Ironclad Android data safety with strict byte-verification checks before any source cleanup. 🫡
- Live folder watching that automatically picks up new external screenshots without resetting your scroll position.

Hope it makes organizing your screenshots feel effortless. Enjoy organizing! 😎
